about: D'Amore Law Group holds six verified offices, two in Portland and one each in Lake Oswego, Bend, Tacoma and Vancouver, and names twenty people. Its own description is of an Oregon and Washington practice.

Contingency fees, a free case evaluation, a 24 hour line and pages in Spanish, published, along with a statement that the firm covers case preparation costs and the client owes nothing if the case is lost. 82 reviews at 4.93.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Oregon does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Supreme Court of Oregon on the conduct of Oregon State Bar members, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 457 published discipline decisions of the Supreme Court of Oregon on the conduct of Oregon State Bar members, 1951 to 2017. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 6 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. We read the Active Businesses register (data.oregon.gov tckn-sxa6), published as open data by the Oregon Secretary of State and could not identify this firm in it: 1 entity name(s) contain the firm's name and none of them agrees on both the name and the city. A miss there is not evidence that the firm is unregistered, so this gate is unresolved rather than failed.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 19 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 82 public client reviews across 6 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 1998-11-30, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
